style: STYLE: traditional Chinese shadow puppet (piying) leather cut-outs exactly in the style of the reference image: dyed translucent leather in cinnabar red, bronze-gold, jade green, black lacquer and deep brown, intricate hollowed-out lace carving cut clean through the leather, crisp flat silhouettes with fine dark carved outlines, warm backlit glow. Flat 2D, no perspective, no cast shadows.

fx.prompt:
Use case: hit-effect sprites for a shadow-puppet fighting game. The attached image is ONLY a style reference.
Layout is critical: landscape 3:2 image, exactly two rows by three columns, one separate object centred in each cell, generous empty gutters, objects never touch each other or the edges, no labels, no text. Background: fully transparent if possible, otherwise perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF; lace holes show the background. Do not paint white or near-white colour on the objects; the lightest colour is pale gold.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) a radial impact burst carved like a paper-cut chrysanthemum: sharp pointed petals radiating from the centre, lace cut inside, gold with a cinnabar centre; (2) a bigger critical-hit starburst: eight long flame-shaped rays, carved flame lace, red and gold; (3) a single carved crescent slash arc, thick in the middle and tapering to two sharp points, cloud lace cut inside, cinnabar red.
ROW 2 left to right: (1) one small cinnabar red carved leather petal (blood drop shaped leaf with a tiny lace cut); (2) one small gold flame-shaped ember with a carved swirl; (3) one small torn scrap of brown leather with ragged edges (ash).

scenery.prompt:
Use case: background scenery props for a shadow-puppet theatre game (Chinese folklore, a drought-stricken mountain village). The attached image is ONLY a style reference - do not copy its characters.
Layout is critical: landscape 3:2 image, exactly two rows by three columns, one separate prop centred in each cell standing on a flat horizontal baseline at the bottom of its cell, generous empty gutters, props never touch each other or the edges, no labels, no text, no people. Background: fully transparent if possible, otherwise perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF; lace holes show the background. Do not paint white or near-white colour on the props; the lightest colour is warm amber. Props are carved mostly in dark brown and black leather with sparse red and gold accents, so they read as scenery behind brighter characters.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) a wide range of steep layered mountains with cloud lace carving; (2) a gnarled old pine tree with carved cloud-shaped foliage clusters; (3) a small temple pavilion with curved roof, carved lattice windows and pillars.
ROW 2 left to right: (1) a ruined village house with a broken tiled roof and carved lattice door; (2) a small arched stone bridge with carved railings; (3) a dead withered tree with twisted bare branches.
